title: Codex Scientiae JSONL header record
description: The container-level metadata row of a JSONL store, distinguished from record rows by __type__. This is the base every kind gets; a kind carrying its own container metadata declares a schema that extends it. additionalProperties is true so an extending schema can add fields without restating this one.

kind.description: The KIND of the store this header opens.

version.description: The declaring kind's VERSION, not the schema's.
